t: A pocket radio receiver that turns a computer into a shortwave listening post.
steps: Buy the receiver from iTead or a radio dealer such as Airspy.US or Moonraker.
Get an antenna, such as a long wire or a passive loop for shortwave.
Install SDR# on Windows or GQRX on Linux and macOS.
Plug the receiver into a USB 2.0 port and connect the antenna.
Select the Airspy HF+ device in the app and press start.
Tune to a local FM station to check that sound comes through.
Explore the shortwave bands in the evening for distant stations.
meta: Open Code. From $169. A few stores.
